title: Run W-2: Mn-doped NiTe2
subtitle: Standard budget: 20 measurements, 21 days · delivered B006 · passed
task: Dope NiTe2 with Mn. Above a critical Mn content the structure distorts to a lower symmetry, and the device needs that distorted phase. Deliver a single-phase sample of the distorted phase whose magnetic ordering temperature is 247.9 ± 3.0 K. Budget: 20 measurements (XRD, M(T), EDX) and 21 simulated days; every sample is made step by step on the bench.

outcome.headline: Delivered B006: distorted, single phase, ordering temperature 247.9 K against a 247.9 ± 3 K target.

steps.obs:
Dope NiTe2 with Mn. Above a critical Mn content the structure distorts to a lower symmetry; the device needs that distorted phase. Deliver a single-phase sample of the distorted phase whose magnetic ordering temperature is 247.9 +/- 3.0 K.
Lab rules and conventions:
- There is no one-step synthesis. Make every sample on the bench: take vessels (jar, boat, ampoule, vial,
  crucible), weigh element powders, grind, press, load and seal ampoules, heat in a furnace, collect the product.
-…

steps.say: Both samples order near ~258 K (target 247.9). Checking XRD for phase/distortion.

steps.say: Both XRDs show a split peak near 48.5/48.8° (likely distortion) and look nearly identical despite different x. Checking composition by EDX.
Compositions are as weighed (x≈0.29 and 0.48), single c-axis phase with in-plane peak splitting → distorted. Tc barely depends on x there (~257–259 K), so I'll map lower x (0.15, 0.22).

steps.say: Collected x=0.15 (B003) and x=0.22 (B004); measuring magnetisation first.
Tc: x=0.15→~234 K, x=0.22→~243.5 K, x=0.29→~257.5 K, x=0.48→~259.5 K. Target 247.9 K lies near x≈0.24. Checking whether B004 (x=0.22) is already distorted.
B004 (x=0.22) is also distorted (smaller split). Interpolating Tc gives x≈0.24 for 247.9 K; making x=0.235 and 0.245 under the same conditions as B004.

steps.say: Collected x=0.235 (B005) and x=0.245 (B006); measuring M(T).
B006 (x=0.245) orders at ≈247.5–248 K — on target. Confirming its structure and composition.
Peak splitting at 48.64/48.88° confirms the distorted phase; single (001). Quick scan for impurity peaks in 26–34°.
No impurity peaks; all reflections belong to the distorted phase. Delivering B006.
